records.scope: CDS owns patient-specific recommendation proposals, including clinical pathways, preventive screening, surgical planning, precision treatment and digital therapy proposals. Medication, genomic results and actual treatment remain their source owners. These distinct profiles do not constitute one approved algorithm or autonomous treatment authority. Pediatric proposals retain developmental stage and guardian/assent context. Source-specific scope: AI Surgical Planning Assistant
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded precision-clinical-recommendations artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every source clause with source-specific applicability, patient/tenant identity, evidence versions, uncertainty and correction lineage. Unverified or stale context must remain explicit; never infer absent disease, permission or clinical eligibility. Test wrong-patient, revoked consent, missing inputs, conflicting sources and downstream invalidation. Qualified clinical acceptance and actual service integration remain required.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

Knowledge certification and governance features record externally authenticated approval; generated text cannot certify itself. Knowledge graphs, causal labels, disease associations, image enhancement and omics findings remain model assertions with source lineage, never replacement source records or clinically confirmed facts. Population analytics must use authorized aggregate projections; privacy is not established by calling an output anonymous. Multiple core/platform labels extend the same AI capability and do not create new engines. Source-specific scope: AI Knowledge Distribution Manager
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded ai-runtime-knowledge-and-derived-artifacts artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every source clause with source-specific applicability, patient/tenant identity, evidence versions, uncertainty and correction lineage. Unverified or stale context must remain explicit; never infer absent disease, permission or clinical eligibility. Test wrong-patient, revoked consent, missing inputs, conflicting sources and downstream invalidation. Qualified clinical acceptance and actual service integration remain required. Cache keys bind tenant, purpose, input versions, authorization epoch and model/release; correction and revocation invalidate reuse. Preserve raw image and transform history. No uncontrolled online clinical learning; evaluate each intended use, population, calibration, fairness, drift and abstention. Family/genomic comparisons require independent relative permissions.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded ai-runtime-knowledge-and-derived-artifacts artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every source clause with source-specific applicability, patient/tenant identity, evidence versions, uncertainty and correction lineage. Unverified or stale context must remain explicit; never infer absent disease, permission or clinical eligibility. Test wrong-patient, revoked consent, missing inputs, conflicting sources and downstream invalidation. Qualified clinical acceptance and actual service integration remain required. Cache keys bind tenant, purpose, input versions, authorization epoch and model/release; correction and revocation invalidate reuse. Preserve raw image and transform history. No uncontrolled online clinical learning; evaluate each intended use, population, calibration, fairness, drift and abstention. Family/genomic comparisons require independent relative permissions.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

Knowledge graphs, causal labels, disease associations, image enhancement and omics findings remain model assertions with source lineage, never replacement source records or clinically confirmed facts. Population analytics must use authorized aggregate projections; privacy is not established by calling an output anonymous. Multiple core/platform labels extend the same AI capability and do not create new engines. Source-specific scope: AI Healthcare Super Intelligence
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded ai-runtime-knowledge-and-derived-artifacts artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every source clause with source-specific applicability, patient/tenant identity, evidence versions, uncertainty and correction lineage. Unverified or stale context must remain explicit; never infer absent disease, permission or clinical eligibility. Test wrong-patient, revoked consent, missing inputs, conflicting sources and downstream invalidation. Qualified clinical acceptance and actual service integration remain required. Cache keys bind tenant, purpose, input versions, authorization epoch and model/release; correction and revocation invalidate reuse. Preserve raw image and transform history. No uncontrolled online clinical learning; evaluate each intended use, population, calibration, fairness, drift and abstention. Family/genomic comparisons require independent relative permissions.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
